name: SVD-Compressed Attention with Importance-Aware Lagrangian Rank Allocation.
description: SVD-Compressed Attention with Importance-Aware Lagrangian Rank Allocation.  Truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) attention compression module with Lagrangian spectral-entropy optimal rank budgeting and optional low-rank plus sparse residual decomposition.
